title: The Patriarchs
description: God chose one family — Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph — to bless the whole world through.

waypoints.title: One Family, One Promise
waypoints.body: God called Abraham to leave his home and promised to make him into a great nation. That promise passed to his son Isaac, then his grandson Jacob (renamed Israel), and then Jacob's son Joseph, who saved his whole family from famine in Egypt.

waypoints.title: Forgiving Like Joseph
waypoints.body: Joseph forgave his brothers even though they had done something terrible to him. Is there someone you need to forgive this week?
